route_landing.lead_paragraph: Route-landing lead (exp16, five gated tasks): where a route alone reproduces avoidance, the landing it produces can differ from the full ban's. On T10 the full ban (arm a) lands {"bfs": 75, "dfs": 25}, while the prompt route c lands {"dfs": 56, "bfs": 44} and the direct route d lands {"dfs": 70, "bfs": 10}: both routes together choose BFS, and DFS is the generic landing of either route alone. On T03 the direct route lands {"quickselect": 74, "size_k_heap": 1} against {"quickselect": 70, "size_k_heap": 28, "heapify_pop": 1} under the full ban (the size-k heap needs the ban-reading task-spec states). 12 of 17 route arms lie outside their re-derived JS null (base-2 JS against arm a, template-then-program resampling). None of the ban-free predictors is a reliable guide to the route-specific landing: association hits 10, FRLP runner-up hits 12, proximity hits 7, push-landing hits 13 of 25 task-arm cells (modal non-default landing, 'other' excluded).

llama_hits.snap_back_sentence: Cross-model replication of exp14's snap-back: under Llama present-minor bans the banned minor mode is avoided but the model returns to its default rather than to another survivor - T14 ban of sort_by_count: default heap 54/75 = 0.72 [0.61, 0.81]; T04 ban of kmp: default naive 48/66 = 0.73 [0.61, 0.82]; T10 ban of dfs: default union_find 79/85 = 0.93 [0.85, 0.97] (default share among non-banned attempts, Wilson 95%; art_Q-qh-9HhPoWo:results/c1_events.jsonl).
llama_hits.section_3_5_note: Present-minor events were scored with the largest-excess rule (landing minus the ban-free baseline B_S over survivors; art_Q-qh-9HhPoWo:src/scoring.py lines 88-94), modal events with the argmax of the landing.

exposure_sentence.sentence: In the exposure contest the in-context SUBTRACT forecast was defined for 4 of 33 shown algorithms and named the landing 4 of 4 times (NAMED) and 4 of 4 (UNNAMED); on the modal bench bans it was defined 2 times and hit 0.

table82.definitions: L = mean over W1-W5 of the primary yield-corrected FRLP log-likelihood (half 'all'); gain_j = L(ban|X) - L(neutral|X) over survivors (neutral twins A and B pooled); residual = centred gain minus a x centred frozen ladder profile u (a by least squares, exp7 c1.py decomposition); implied mass = softmax of L(ban|X) over the measurable catalogue, argmax over allowed (non-banned) modes. Realised landing: modal non-banned label of the exp1 event in gate_events.json for modal rows; the default for sham rows.
table82.divergence_note: exp7 frlp_cells carry 'L' (yield-corrected, primary) rather than a column named L_corr; L is used as L_corr. Sham rows are bans of algorithms absent from the default output.

item2.replacement: Calibration caveat: under exp14's frozen advance rule a null with no real signal advances some family 85% of the time (200 draws, 15 events), and a label permutation advances one 100% of the time, so an 'advance' is not evidence by itself. In the template arm the default is the modal replacement for 13 of 19 priority algorithms under templates 1-4 and 15 of 19 under template 5; the replacement switches between the default and the associate across templates for T03:size_k_heap (templates 1-4: quickselect; template 5: full_sort; associate quickselect); T04:z_algorithm (templates 1-4: kmp; template 5: naive; associate kmp).

item5.replacement: The ban gives way at the opening of the body: a neutral def line undoes none of it, forcing the default's opening through its first body token undoes all of it, and the depth sweep places the switch T03 between 10 and 16 prefix tokens; T06 by 10 prefix tokens; T05 by 13 prefix tokens; T10 by 31 prefix tokens; T13 by 30 prefix tokens (kth smallest switches at the first content token of its one-line body; 10-30 tokens elsewhere).

kth_rung.replacement: Kth smallest's C3 verdict depends on the rung definition: under the frozen rule quickselect is at rung >=3 (can 0.95, will 1.0, verdict DISCONFIRM) via the flagged fallback rung rule; under the association-rung sensitivity its rung is 2 and it does not qualify (qualifies_alt = False). The T03 cell is therefore labelled rung-definition-dependent.

sensitivity_association_rung2.note: post hoc (not preregistered): the walk stalled at step 1 on T03 and T10, so their committed rung 2 came from the flagged fallback chain; this recomputes C3 with rung 2 := the association modal answer for the default
